counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.0170359 to 0.0 with all other fields identical; removes noisy angle measurement that destabilizes the state-feedback controller at large dt ~0.02, so pole stays upright

explanation: "Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright at step 15 (theta -0.868 rad, limit 0.8) after monotonic divergence from theta 0.10. With dt at maximum 0.02 and sensor_noise 0.017, the controller receives noisy theta and, acting once per outer step, applies mis-timed forces (16-24 N well below force_limit but wrong sign/phase). Omega grows to -7.37 rad/s, cart accelerates to 5.3 m/s, energy rises to 17.0. Counterfactual with sensor_noise=0.0 and otherwise identical plant/steps passes, confirming noise-induced feedback instability at coarse dt is the cause, not plant limits or pushes (none)."
vision_note: From steps 12 to 14 the pole tilts progressively further from upright while the blue cart stays near the center of the track. At step 15 the tilt exceeds the limit and the pole tip turns red, marking the pole_upright violation.
